verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents its own automation layer: Pipelines for automated workflows, including AI-powered workflows triggered from the pipeline. It also documents PR code review and change-management workflows. The evidence never states that pipeline or automation definitions are versioned alongside code, reviewed through PRs, or rolled back, so that link is only implied. missing for 10: explicit evidence that automation/pipeline definitions are version-controlled, a documented review flow specific to automation changes, any rollback capability for automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
